g.text: Mesh: the nodes we hear, joined by what their packets carried, a link colored by its packets from blue
. Links between repeaters need a capture with rx path mode
Not to scale: only the west-east and north-south order of the nodes is kept.
nbr: a last-hop neighbor; node: another repeater of a path
echoes of our sends it gave. links: packets whose path joined it to another node. Nodes with no km have no
position in neighbors.json: they are not on the map; an ambiguous hash is not drawn.
